feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 29 June 2026 10:48pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 29 June 2026 at 10:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Local strong winds for a time.


##Synopsis##

Flat ridge of high pressure is displaced from the west by an area of low pressure and associated frontal zone.


##Wind##

South 4 or 5, increasing occasionally 6 in the west of the area for a time tomorrow morning. Decreasing South or Southwest 3 or 4 in the afternoon, veering West or Northwest in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle, becoming fair later tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Northwest 3 or 4, increasing Northwest 4 or 5 overnight into Wednesday, then backing and decreasing West 3 or 4 on Wednesday morning. Gradually backing and increasing Southwest 5 or 6 during the afternoon and evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight for a time, then building moderate later on Wednesday.


##Weather##

Fair, then patchy rain later on Wednesday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain later.
